description: Email a current member of your shop a one-time sign-in link that opens one page: board (the day board, for owner or office), override (mark a job or visit done anyway, owner only), or capture (job photos, for anyone on the job; a field worker must be assigned to a visit on it). Owners and office only. The member is named by membership_id, so the link only goes to someone in the shop. The link works once and expires in 15 minutes. The page still checks access when it opens.

params.description: board: date (YYYY-MM-DD, optional). override: kind (job or visit) and id. capture: job_id.

name: members_sendPage
